report:
Right kidney, radical nephrectomy

Received in formalin is a right radical nephrectomy specimen weighing 485 g and measuring 14.0 x 9.5 x 7.0 cm. Sectioning reveals a 52 mm (52 x 44 x 38 mm) tumour in the upper pole, circumscribed golden-yellow cortical mass with focal haemorrhage. Adrenal gland: unremarkable and uninvolved by tumour. Sections are submitted in 12 blocks.

(A1) ureteral and renal vascular margins.
(A2-A7) tumour with renal sinus interface and capsule.
(A8-A9) non-neoplastic kidney.
(A10) adrenal gland.
(A11-A12) renal hilar lymph nodes.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Radical nephrectomy
- Specimen laterality: Right
- Tumour focality: Unifocal
- Tumour site: Upper pole
- Tumour size (greatest dimension): 52 mm (52 x 44 x 38 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
- Histologic grade (WHO/ISUP): G2: Nucleoli conspicuous and eosinophilic at
  400x, visible but not prominent at 100x
- Sarcomatoid features: Not identified
- Rhabdoid features: Not identified
- Tumour necrosis: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion (excluding renal vein / IVC): Not identified
- Tumour extension: Limited to kidney
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the kidney show clear cell renal cell carcinoma, G2: Nucleoli conspicuous and eosinophilic at 400x, visible but not prominent at 100x. Nests and acini of polygonal tumour cells with optically clear cytoplasm are separated by a delicate branching sinusoidal capillary network.

Margins
- Surgical margins: All margins uninvolved by invasive carcinoma
- Distance to closest margin: 6 mm (perinephric fat margin)

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 0 of 4 involved (renal hilar)

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT1b pN0

Additional findings
- Non-neoplastic kidney: Arterionephrosclerosis / vascular disease

RIGHT KIDNEY, radical nephrectomy:
- CLEAR CELL RENAL CELL CARCINOMA, G2: Nucleoli conspicuous and eosinophilic at
  400x, visible but not prominent at 100x, 52 mm
- Confined to the kidney
- Surgical margins clear (closest 6 mm, perinephric fat margin)
- 0 of 4 regional lymph nodes involved
- pT1b pN0 (AJCC 8th edition).
